entries.text: Can't sleep again, it's almost 2am. My JEE mock results were bad and my parents keep comparing me to my cousin. I feel like a failure.
So tired all day, I couldn't focus in coaching class. Kept reading the same page five times.
Tried the breathing exercise from the app before studying. It actually helped me calm down a bit.
Exams in two weeks and I can't stop worrying about everything. My heart was racing in the morning.
Talked to my sister about the pressure from my parents. Felt lighter after that.
Still waking up at 3am most nights, but I fell asleep faster after the breathing exercises.
Mock test went better today. Still nervous about the boards, but less than before.
Went for a walk with a friend in the evening. I should be studying more but I'm trying not to panic.
